data.title: Health insurer rejects reimbursement for private MRT
data.summary: Beispiel Ersatzkasse rejected your application to be reimbursed for a private MRI (MRT) examination, because you did not contact them before the treatment. You may file an objection (Widerspruch).
data.explanation: Your health insurer refuses to reimburse the private MRI. It says reimbursement under § 13 (3) SGB V requires that it could not provide an urgent service in time or wrongly refused it, and you did not contact it before treatment. You may decide to file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or recorded in person at the insurer. The app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. Consider advice from a patient advisory service or your insurer if unsure.

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) with Beispiel Ersatzkasse, in writing or recorded in person.

key_facts.value: No contact with insurer before treatment
key_facts.quote: Sie haben sich vor der Behandlung jedoch nicht an uns gewandt.
